notes.event:ko: a fighter down for good (no health bar: one cut can kill)
notes.event:hit: a cut lands without a KO, shown on screen (an IPPON call is the killing cut, not this)
notes.event:guard: a blocked cut, shown on screen: an attack inside its blade's hit window meets the blade of a fighter that is not attacking, and both stay up. Code-level test (versus-2p-blade-contact-1, all three contacts at 9235, 10557, 10615): fighter_ResolveWeaponContact runs (blade on blade); the attacker in move_kind 2 with unk_288 5, the other fighter in walk move 0x801494ac (move_kind 0x19, reached by holding RIGHT with no button, movegraph) with unk_288 0 and only RIGHT held on its pad; after it the walker gets the common-file move kind 0x2C and the attacker its own kind 0xE, kinds no input reaches (0x2C offers a CROSS counter-cut, taken after the first contact); the landed leg cut instead gives the target the common kind 3 and the attacker carries on (versus-2p-wound-moves-1, 9482)
